clips.title: The story
paras: Ships crowd Auberdine's docks, linking Darkshore with Teldrassil and the Eastern Kingdoms. The night elven town is the Alliance's main port in northern Kalimdor, set between the Veiled Sea and pine-covered bluffs.

Auberdine sits on the Veiled Sea, the only major settlement still thriving in Darkshore. Its ships sail to Stormwind Harbor and, by way of Southshore, to Menethil Harbor. Ferries cross to Rut'theran Village beneath the boughs of the World Tree. Unlike Teldrassil's secluded treetop cities, Auberdine welcomes travelers from across the sea. Lamps light its stone streets, and dwarves and gnomes mingle with merchants among low, arched timber houses.

Elder Thundris Windweaver and the Auberdine Village Council govern the town, coordinating Darkshore's defense with the local Sentinels. Auberdine is a vital trade hub, though its name is rarely spoken in Darnassus, where memory dwells on the great cities lost to the Sundering. Trouble presses in from every side: aggressive murlocs raid fishing boats along the strand, corrupted Blackwood furbolgs push from the south, and foul magic drifting down from Felwood agitates the wildlife.
